newsitem.title: USA: Roberts gets FDA clearance for ProAmatine.
newsitem.headline: Roberts gets FDA clearance for ProAmatine.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday that the Food and Drug Administration cleared its low blood pressure medication, ProAmatine, for U.S. marketing.
The company said it will launch the medication shortly.

Also on Monday Roberts said it concluded private placements representing $115 million in gross proceeds, consisting of the sale of $105 million Roberts five percent convertible preferred stock and the sale of $9.9 million common stock.
The preferred stock purchasers, consisting of a group of institutional investors, have agreed to restrictions on the resale of any common stock acquired on conversion.
Roberts said it believes the terms of this transaction favor long-term holdings of the preferred stock prior to conversion.
